learning_objective: 🎯 Let us read a funny story about a giant laddoo and the sweet lesson of sharing food.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Grandma makes a very special treat. It is a giant, round, golden yellow laddoo that smells delicious!
The laddoo is so big that one person cannot eat it all. If you eat too many sweets alone, your tummy might hurt.
The best way to enjoy a giant treat is to break it into pieces. When we share our food with friends, it tastes even sweeter.

fun_activity.title: 🟡 Clay Laddoo Shop
fun_activity.instructions: Take some play-dough or clay. Roll it in your hands to make one giant laddoo and five tiny laddoos!

quick_recap: ⭐ The story is about a very big and yummy golden laddoo.
⭐ We should not eat too many sweets all by ourselves.
⭐ Sharing delicious food with our friends brings us closer together.
